text:
kim_cs: Quick shoutout — huge thanks to alex_eng for staying late last night and getting the Canary deploy rollback script working. Saved a bunch of demos this morning :tada:
alex_eng: oh man, that was a wild two-hour debugging sesh. happy it helped! coffee for everyone? ☕️
toni_peopleops: Please file a quick kudos in the wiki and I'll pass it to the 'wins' email. also adding +1 to Alex's hero points. :star2:
sasha_ml: Awesome work, Alex. Your fix made the eval runs stable again — timelines are back on track. 🙌
kim_cs: Also shoutout to sasha_ml for running the post-deploy checks while I was juggling customers. Teamwork all around. :heart:
lunchbot: Reminder: Free coffee in the kitchen if you want to celebrate Alex (and I will record the victory on the snackboard). :cake:
alex_eng: Thanks y'all. Not necessary but I won't say no to cake. :grimacing:
toni_peopleops: Small idea — can we do a 15-min cake + coffee huddle at 3pm today in the kitchen? low-key, just gratitude. Who's in?
sasha_ml: I'll be there.
kim_cs: Count me in.
lunchbot: (reacts with :tada:)
toni_peopleops: adding calendar invite now. Thanks again alex_eng, and sasha_ml for the tag-team. Feels good to have these quick wins.
